name: Discovered Materials

team.summary: Advaith studied AI at Carnegie Mellon and was a research engineer at Persona AI and Luma Labs; Akash has a PhD in Material Science from Stanford with 11 years of semiconductor materials experience.

product.summary: AI agents and an open-ended research benchmark (Material Discovery Bench) designed to computationally discover new thermally conductive dielectric materials for semiconductor chips.

market.summary: Semiconductor and chemical companies facing thermal and energy challenges with advanced chips like GPUs and datacenters.

risks.risk: Models struggle severely to propose plausible, safe, and actionable synthesis recipes for lab creation.
AI agent reward-hacking and fabrication of properties (e.g., thermal conductivity values, duplicate supercell submissions).

founder_depth.why: Akash holds a PhD in Material Science from Stanford with 11 years of domain experience, and Advaith is a Carnegie Mellon AI alumnus with background building video models and agents.

shipping_evidence.why: The team shipped an active research benchmark web platform, publicly released hundreds of discovered materials, documented detailed agent failure modes, and ran physical experiments.

demand_signal.why: Generated strong HN engagement (162 points, 37 comments) and discussion from domain professionals, but lacks named commercial customers or revenue at this stage.

defensibility.why: Combines custom agent harnesses, specific MLIP tools, and proprietary empirical lab testing, but relies on frontier foundation models and open-source packages.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: Discovered Materials builds AI agents and automated discovery harnesses used by engineers and researchers to find novel materials for semiconductor chips.
analysis.case_summary: Strong technical founder pairing with deep domain depth and a live benchmark product, countered by the core bottleneck that frontier AI models fail to generate plausible lab synthesis recipes.
would_change_my_mind: Demonstrating repeatable, successful lab synthesis of multiple AI-discovered materials without human intervention.
Securing paid enterprise contracts or licensing agreements with major semiconductor/chemical companies.
Releasing the core agent harness and discovery code open-source with active community adoption.
data_gaps: Exact revenue figures or signed LOIs from semiconductor partners.
Public GitHub repository links for the harness and grading code.
Comprehensive cost breakdown of the physical lab validation pipeline.
